column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 100, 101, 103, 107, 108,
109, 110, 120, 121, 122, 124 and 125 of Block 02, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 320019, situated in the Village of Niyangama
within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 1153 - Inguruwatta in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Udapalatha, in the District of
Kandy, in the Province of Central, referred to in Notice No. 030005 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the
Gazette No. 1173/02 of 26th February, 2001 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
